note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by BRIK, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: —AND THAT'S WHY I BIT THE DRONE. no i'm not sorry. no i would not do it differently. i am currently evaluating whether to bite it again
BRIK. Demolished District. ex-KILLDOZER operator, meaning i used to drive the machine that ate buildings for a paycheck. now i live in what the machine left behind. full circle. corporate edition

asked NEKOCORP once why execs get twelve fish breaks a shift and the factory floor splits one (1) communal scrap of tuna between forty of us. by morning my apartment was a HOLOGRAPHIC PARKING LOT. no cars even park there. it's just for the ad

BYTE keeps offering to spoof my heat signature so the drones stop pinging the vent. BYTE i love you but no. i don't want to hide from the drones. i want the drones to remember my face and regret their scheduling choices

paperwork calls me a 'domestic extremist.' my mother, who i have not seen since the demolition crew came through, still calls me HANDSOME. i contain multitudes. one of the multitudes bites rotor blades on sight
KNIFEBOY pinged me about the tuna shipment next week. obviously in. obviously bringing teeth. we are not what you'd call a subtle operation, we are barely what you'd call a plan
anyway. vent's cold, drone count is up, mother still thinks i'll 'grow out of it.' i will not be growing out of it. see you at the next demolition, i'll be the one still standing on the rubble
